title: Callaway Apex Ai300 9 Iron, Graphite Stiff, Right-Handed, New

comparisons.notes: New Apex Ai300 single iron, right-handed graphite stiff, configurable to 9 iron (37 degrees, standard length), starting at $207.00; built to order from Callaway.
New Callaway Apex Ai300 custom individual iron at $207.00 with club, shaft and length selectable; usually ships in 3-5 days.

writeup: Woot has a new Callaway Apex Ai300 9 iron with a right-handed graphite stiff shaft at standard length for $79.99. 2nd Swing Golf and Golf USA Manhattan both charge $207 for the same new Ai300 single iron, so this is about 61% less, a savings of $127. It's a handy pickup if you're replacing a single club in an Ai300 set, but Woot showed only one left.
